import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Click on the Orders link to navigate to the Orders page
    orders_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Orders", exact=True)
    await orders_link.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for Orders page to load
    
    # Apply filter for canceled orders
    # Look for a combobox for status filter
    status_filter = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status")
    if await status_filter.count() > 0:
        await status_filter.select_option("Canceled")
    else:
        # If no combobox, try alternative selectors
        pass
    
    # Click a search or filter button to apply the filter
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    if await search_button.count() > 0:
        await search_button.click()
    
    await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for results to load
    
    # Retrieve and return the page content as-is
    results = await page.content()
    return results
